reason: CVE-2026-59890 affects source-distribution publishing with Unicode-normalizing filesystems (macOS APFS/HFS+). This Linux model server does not build or publish sdists; that operation is absent from its request path. The fix exists only in 83.0.0 and later, with no 80.x backport, while vLLM 0.32.0 requires setuptools <81 on Python 3.12; vLLM 0.33.0 and LMCache 0.5.7.post1, the latest releases on 2026-11-15, keep the same <81 bound, so installing 83 would break the declared requirements of both. Review again if the runtime or its build responsibilities change, or when vLLM or LMCache allow setuptools 83 or later.

The path escape needs Windows: a drive-qualified absolute path in a wheel's namespace_packages.txt makes os.path.join discard the egg directory during setuptools' legacy install_as_egg path. This model server is a Linux image and installs no wheels at runtime. vLLM 0.32.0 requires setuptools <81 on Python 3.12, so the fixed 84.1.0 would break its declared requirements. Review again if the runtime or its build responsibilities change.

CVE-2026-114603 is reached through TraceState.from_header when a W3C propagator extracts an inbound tracestate header. In vLLM 0.32.0 that extraction (vllm/tracing/otel.py extract_trace_context) runs only when --otlp-traces-endpoint is set; build_vllm_command never passes it or --tool-server and accepts no extra arguments, and no ASGI OpenTelemetry instrumentation is installed or registered. LMCache 0.5.6, the latest release in the base image, requires opentelemetry-api<=1.40.0, so the fixed 1.45.1 would break its declared requirements. Review again if tracing is enabled or LMCache allows a fixed release.

CVE-2026-126360 is quadratic-time regex backtracking in TraceContextTextMapPropagator.extract() on a crafted traceparent that embeds a newline. In vLLM 0.32.0 the propagator sees request data only through extract_trace_context (vllm/tracing/otel.py), fed with trace_headers that AsyncLLM.add_request (vllm/v1/engine/async_llm.py) drops when otlp_traces_endpoint is None; the other caller, _get_smart_context, reads only os.environ. build_vllm_command never passes --otlp-traces-endpoint or --tool-server and accepts no extra arguments, and vLLM creates no MCP server, so the MCP SDK's OpenTelemetryMiddleware (the params._meta carrier the advisory names) never runs; conforming HTTP header values cannot carry the newline either. LMCache 0.5.7.post1, its latest release on 2026-11-15, requires opentelemetry-api<=1.40.0, so the fixed 1.45.2 would break its declared requirements. Review again if tracing is enabled, vLLM gains an MCP server, or LMCache allows a fixed release.
